method: 109 ordinary WebFetch page fetches (under the 130 cap): the home page of each of the 105 non-Brazil companies with a website, asking the same question of each page (Brazilian founder or founders, office or operations in Brazil, founded in Brazil); plus 4 extra pages where the home page was thin or a deeper page was tried (vtex /en-us/company/ returned 404, vtex home page read, kiggu /about read, genspark /about returned 403). Not done: a separate about or team page for every company, so a founder statement that sits only on a deeper page could be missed. Pages naming Brazil only as a customer, a language option (Portugues, pt-br, PT (BR)) or a tax-coverage list were not counted as a presence. The four companies with no website field (eversec, nisos, rws, whitespace) were not fetched. Founder nationality was recorded only where a page states it; no nationality was inferred from names.
